question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e**. 'Shields'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is: **shields**
 
• The word** "shields" **in this context refers to the ozone layer's function of providing protection by blocking or absorbing the sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
